record.binding_note: 20 forwarded ports is a workable budget, but the binding constraint in practice is the vendor's own stability warning and the no-refund rule: the page says the toy products are unstable and must not host production, so the machine can vanish without recourse.

identity_cost.detail: a WHMCS account whose registration form marks first name, last name, street address, city and postcode as required and email as mandatory-verified; the phone field is present and labelled 手机号码 but is not marked required, and no national ID field exists in the form source. Payment rails could not be read, because the cart page requires a login before it lists a payment method, so the card requirement is inferred from the absence of any published rail rather than read. No ID document is requested at registration.

record.reliability_note: the vendor's own warning, quoted: '玩具产品稳定性较差, 请不要部署生产项目' (the toy products are relatively unstable, do not deploy production projects); it also states '不保证中国大陆地区直连' and '滥用将直接删除服务' (abuse results in immediate deletion), and that all hosts have China-mainland IPv4 weak protocols disabled
record.confidence_note: price, shape, port count, IPv6 prefix, traffic allowance, the stock markers and the vendor's own warnings are quoted from the group page read; the registration form fields are quoted from the form source read. record.notes: The lowest published price among documented hosts by a factor of four: CNY 10.00 a year is USD 1.4969 a year, USD 0.1247 a month, for 384 MB, 1 GB of disk, 20 NAT ports, an IPv6 /128 and 1 TB a month. It is also the weakest offer on every axis that is not price. The vendor calls the class '玩具' (toy) and says in the plan body not to deploy production projects on it; abuse deletes the service with no refund and no balance return. The location list is 23 SKUs and 10 of them printed '0 可用' (0 available) when read, so stock is partial rather than absent: the UK, Ireland, Los Angeles NAT1/2, Netherlands NAT2/3, Buffalo, Dallas, Toronto, Chicago and Japan NAT2 SKUs carried no out-of-stock marker. Not established: whether the 20 ports are assigned by the host or chosen by the buyer, whether SSH is one of the 20, whether UDP is forwarded, and the payment rails. The order links on the store page ('/store/toy-vps/<slug>') resolve back to the category page, so the configuration step that would print the port rule was not reachable without adding to a cart, which this category does not do.

extras.price_arithmetic: CNY 10.00 a year x (12.0557 RUB per CNY / 80.5381 RUB per USD) = CNY 10.00 x USD 0.149689 = USD 1.4969 a year; / 12 = USD 0.1247 a month on annual prepay. Both rates from the CBR table dated 24.10.2026. Out of pocket for the first year is USD 1.4969. A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so the 24/7 and 10 h/day figures are the same.
extras.renewal_note: one annual price is printed per SKU with no strike-through and no promo code, so CNY 10.00 is the ordinary rate; the renewal cycle is not stated separately
